name: Apptronik Apollo 2
summary: A general-purpose humanoid with five-finger hands, offered on legs or on a wheeled base, that today only works in Apptronik’s own data-collection sites and at pilot customers.

germany.statusNote: Not for sale: Apptronik uses Apollo 2 fleets for data collection and training at its Robot Park sites (Austin and partner sites such as Mercedes-Benz and GXO) and names Apollo 3 as its upcoming commercial fleet. No price, no distributor, only a "get started" contact form. Mercedes-Benz is an investor and pilot partner, not a reseller.

specs.label: Swappable battery
specs.conditions: enables 7x22 operation; opportunity charging or tethering also possible

notes: Sold in two mobility configurations (legs or wheeled base); the record covers both.
No payload, runtime, size or weight figures are published for Apollo 2. The first Apollo (2024) was stated as 5 ft 8 in, 160 lb, able to lift 55 lb.
Hardware safety zones pause motion when a person or object enters a set radius.
